The regression was in `boltons/strutils.py`'s `MultiReplace.__init__`/`sub`. When `sub_map` was empty, `regex_values` ended up empty, so `'|'.join(regex_values)` compiled to an empty-string regex. Matching that against text produces matches with `match.lastgroup == None`, and `_get_value` then did `self.group_map[None]`, raising `KeyError: None`.

Fix: only build `self.combined_pattern` via `re.compile` when there are actual `regex_values`; otherwise set it to `None`. In `sub()`, if `combined_pattern is None`, return the input text unchanged (no substitutions to make).

Fix: when there are no regex_values, set self.combined_pattern = None in __init__, and in sub() return the text unchanged if combined_pattern is None.
